task_completion.description: LibreCAD application is open and active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD window is visible on the desktop with its characteristic toolbars and drawing area.
The Layer List widget shows 'PARCEL_BOUNDARY' with a red icon/color indicator and 'ANNOTATIONS' with a green icon/color indicator.

task_completion.description: A closed polyline is drawn connecting the five survey points (P1-P5).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A red 5-sided closed shape is visible in the drawing area. The vertices should roughly correspond to the coordinates (0,0), (50,0), (55,35), (25,45), and (0,30).

task_completion.description: Text 'PARCEL A-2047' and 'AREA: 2050 sq m' are placed inside the boundary.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Green text strings 'PARCEL A-2047' and 'AREA: 2050 sq m' are visible near the center of the red boundary.

task_completion.description: The drawing is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the file path '~/Documents/LibreCAD/survey_plot.dxf'.

integrity.description: The agent used the LibreCAD GUI to create the drawing rather than just writing a DXF file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with LibreCAD tools (polyline tool, text tool, layer creator) or the command line within LibreCAD.

integrity.description: The agent entered the specific coordinates provided in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD internal command history or coordinate input boxes show the values 0,0; 50,0; 55,35; 25,45; 0,30 being typed.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open an existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the process of creating layers and drawing lines from a blank canvas.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The boundary must be a closed shape with 5 vertices: (0,0), (50,0), (55,35), (25,45), (0,30). The calculated area for these coordinates is exactly 2050 sq m. Layer 'PARCEL_BOUNDARY' must be Red (Color Index 1). Layer 'ANNOTATIONS' must be Green (Color Index 3). The text 'PARCEL A-2047' should be slightly above 'AREA: 2050 sq m' near the center of the plot.
